_comment: office mode: the 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.0 samples stacked as three paragraphs in ONE frame (spaceBefore/After 0). Checks that each paragraph's line-spacing coefficient is applied independently and that inter-paragraph advance = the previous paragraph's last line box, with no extra leading. Compare block heights against line-spacing-100/150/200 rendered alone. Oracle: scripts/office-metrics/line-spacing.pptx group 'ls-stacked'.
